propositions: Comment identity must be based on persistent local HLC timestamp to Jira comment ID mapping rather than normalized body text to prevent collisions and handle same-text comments correctly.

The returned Jira comment ID from add_comment must be captured at both enactment sites (create_one and update_one via update_one_dispatch_comments) and persisted in binding_store before the mutation completes.

Outbound comment bodies must render through RichTextCodec.to_wire with fit-then-serialize ordering, ensuring ADF is fitted before JSON serialization and plaintext truncation never applies to serialized JSON.

Comment sync must be strictly append-only in both directions: new comments sync once, and edits/deletes are never pushed or applied, with the outbound differ skipping on either mapped HLC key or existing jira_comment_id.
The _resolve_codec injection in _diff_comments must be migrated from _IdentityCodec to the real codec to ensure the local dedup key matches the landed wire format.
Crash-durability must be ensured by record_comment_id performing immediate write-ahead save on successful add_comment return, with body-equality test demoted to secondary skip behind map identity.
